title: R′ Acha bar Chana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Rav Sheshet in Eruvin 68b, but Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbah bar bar Chana. In Avodah Zarah 38b and Menachot 31b, Hyman gives Acha bar bar Chana reporting Rabbi Yochanan.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Dikdukei Soferim supplies the variant Rabbah bar bar Chana. Menachot 31b also preserves both Rabbah and Rav Acha bar bar Chana, reporting Rabbi Yochanan.

The consulted William Davidson Eruvin 68b names Rav Acha bar Chana reporting Rav Sheshet. Both Avodah Zarah 38b and Menachot 31b have Rabbah bar bar Chana and an alternative Rav Acha bar bar Chana reporting Rabbi Yochanan. These full Rav forms do not establish Rabbi for the abbreviated heading, which remains R′ Acha. The existing Dikdukei Soferim note is retained as Hyman’s uncollated report; the alternatives and different patronymics are not identified with one another.
